Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
ABOUT INVENTIFF 
 Inventiff is a software development and digital product agency based in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We work as a full-service tech partner for companies of different sizes and industries, helping them turn ideas into scalable digital products, from custom software, web platforms and mobile apps to APIs, integrations and cloud infrastructure. Our team covers the full delivery cycle, from discovery and design to development, testing and ongoing support. 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for a Python Developer to build and maintain backend services, APIs, automations and data-driven features for our clients' projects. You will work across the full lifecycle of a feature, from understanding the business need to shipping and supporting it in production, alongside designers, frontend developers and DevOps engineers. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Design, develop and maintain backend services and APIs using Python 
 Build integrations with third-party services and internal systems 
 Develop automation scripts, data processing pipelines and operational tools 
 Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases and optimize data access 
 Write clean, tested, and well-documented code, and participate in code reviews 
 Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions 
 Troubleshoot, debug, and support applications in production 
 Contribute to architecture discussions and continuous improvement of our practices 
 MUST HAVE 
 3+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on Python 
 Experience with at least one Python web framework (Django, FastAPI, or Flask) 
 Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs 
 Experience with asynchronous programming (asyncio) and task queues (Celery or similar) 
 Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) 
 Experience with testing frameworks (pytest or similar) 
 Understanding of OOP, design patterns, and clean code principles 
 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 
 Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker 
 Experience working in Agile / Scrum teams 
 Good communication skills and English at B2 level or higher 
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis) 
 Experience with data tools (pandas, Airflow) or ETL pipelines 
 Experience with LLM integrations or AI-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain or similar) 
 Experience with Kubernetes 
 Basic frontend knowledge (React, Vue or similar) 
 ﻿ 
 WHAT WE OFFER 
 Fully remote work 
 Long-term collaboration on a variety of client projects and industries 
 Direct communication with clients and stakeholders, no unnecessary layers 
 Room to learn and work with modern tools, including AI-assisted development
